items.title: GE HealthCare adds Lung Guidance and AutoAS artificial intelligence tools to Vscan Air SL handheld ultrasound
items.summary: GE HealthCare announced two features for the Vscan Air SL on 03/11/2026: Lung Guidance (probe guidance across the eight-zone lung protocol, with B-line detection and scoring) and AutoAS (a diagnostic aid flagging possible moderate-to-severe aortic stenosis from at least two views).

items.title: Philips launches the HyperVue Integrated System, a fixed cath-lab version of its coronary imaging and physiology platform
items.summary: Philips announced US commercial availability of the HyperVue Integrated System, a permanently installed, single-room configuration of the HyperVue Imaging System (from its SpectraWAVE acquisition) combining DeepOCT with near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) intravascular imaging and X1-FFR…

items.title: Merit Medical acquires Solo Pace, adding TAVR pacing systems to its cardiac therapies platform
items.summary: Merit Medical announced on 29/10/2026 that it has acquired Solo Pace, Inc., adding the SOLO PACE CONTROL and SOLO PACE FUSION transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) pacing systems.

items.title: PulseAI announces US FDA 510(k) clearance of AI-powered arrhythmia analysis model for wearables
items.summary: PulseAI has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance for its artificial intelligence (AI)-powered arrhythmia analysis model for wearables.

items.title: ISCHEMIA-EXTEND study finds no long-term survival advantage for invasive approach in stable heart disease
items.summary: Patients with stable heart disease and abnormal stress test treated early on with an invasive approach do not live longer than those initially treated with drugs and lifestyle changes alone, randomised trial results show.

items.title: Urgent action needed to cut CVD risk in people with severe mental illness
items.summary: Ministers must take urgent action to address “stark” cardiovascular inequalities that contribute to shorter life expectancy in people with severe mental illness, according to a new report from a leading charity.

items.title: Long Covid linked to 14% higher risk of developing high blood pressure
items.summary: People diagnosed with long Covid had a 14% higher risk of developing high blood pressure than those without the condition, a new study involving more than 1.2 million adults has found.

items.title: Sacubitril-valsartan combination linked to reduced AF recurrence after catheter ablation
items.summary: Among older adults with high blood pressure and atrial fibrillation (AF), treatment with a combination of two blood pressure medications was associated with fewer recurring irregular heart rhythms after an ablation procedure compared to one of the medications alone, as per new, independent, preliminary, late-breaking…

items.title: Out-of-hospital cardiac arrest: comparing interventions across the UK
items.summary:
Introduction:
The occurrence of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) persists at an elevated level globally. In the UK, survival remains low despite extensive research and efforts to implement initiatives targeting prehospital OHCA interventions.

items.title: LBBP leads to reduced cardiac events versus right ventricular pacing in AV block patients
items.summary: People with atrioventricular (AV) block—a type of heart rhythm disorder—had lower incidences of death, hospitalisation for heart failure and pacing-induced cardiomyopathy when the pacemaker technique implemented was left bundle branch pacing (LBBP) rather than right ventricular pacing, according to independent…

items.title: Trial of drug therapy to slow AS progression completes enrolment
items.summary: Kardigan has announced the completion of enrolment in the phase 2b KATALYST-AV trial of ataciguat in people with aortic stenosis (AS).

items.title: StimCardio secures US$30 million financing to advance wearable AF therapeutic
items.summary: StimCardio Medical has announced the closing of its oversubscribed US$30 million Series A financing led by John Slump’s family office, Metis Medtech, with participation from Catalyst Health Ventures, multiple corporate strategic investors, and other new and existing investors.

items.title: RESET-AF 3D study reveals positive six-month outcomes with Biotronik’s investigational PFA system
items.summary: Biotronik today announced the completion of six-month clinical outcomes from the RESET-AF 3D study evaluating its investigational ElePulse pulsed field ablation (PFA) system in patients with symptomatic paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF).

items.title: Sex-specific analysis of SYMPHONY-PE finds comparable outcomes following aspiration thrombectomy
items.summary: Imperative Care has announced new findings from a pre-specified sex-specific analysis of the SYMPHONY-PE investigational device exemption (IDE) trial, which evaluated the Symphony thrombectomy system in patients with intermediate-risk pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: New data demonstrate etripamil nasal spray can convert recurrent PSVT to normal heart rhythm in prior-ablation patients
items.summary: Milestone Pharmaceuticals has announced new data showing that its Cardamyst (etripamil) nasal spray converted approximately two-thirds of patients who experienced recurrent symptomatic paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (PSVT) after a prior catheter ablation to normal heart rhythm within 30 minutes.

items.title: Inquis Medical launches SENSE-PE all-comer postmarket registry of Aventus thrombectomy system
items.summary: Inquis Medical has announced the launch of SENSE-PE, an all-comer postmarket registry evaluating the safety and efficacy of the Aventus thrombectomy system in patients treated for acute pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: Jupiter Endovascular reveals SPIRARE II post-hoc analysis for Vertex thrombectomy system
items.summary: Jupiter Endovascular has revealed findings from new analyses of its SPIRARE II pivotal trial showing that restoring normal pulmonary artery pressure with the Vertex thrombectomy system tracked with right heart recovery at 48 hours.

items.title: TR and quality of life improvements drive superiority at six months in CLASP II TR trial
items.summary: The Pascal Precision (Edwards Lifesciences) transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (TEER) system demonstrated superiority over optimal medical therapy alone for the six-month primary endpoint of the randomised CLASP II TR trial, in patients with symptomatic severe or greater tricuspid regurgitation (TR).

items.title: Reduced-dose NOACs and aspirin non-inferior to DAPT for six-month outcomes after LAA closure
items.summary: Boston Scientific has announced positive six-month primary endpoint results from the SIMPLAAFY randomised controlled trial of the Watchman FLX Pro left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) device.

items.title: TCT 2026: Reduced-dose NOACs and aspirin non-inferior to DAPT for six-month outcomes after LAA closure
items.summary: Boston Scientific has announced positive six-month primary endpoint results from the SIMPLAAFY randomised controlled trial of the Watchman FLX Pro left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) device.

items.title: Prevalence of degenerative mitral valve disease growing rapidly globally
items.summary: The global prevalence of patients with degenerative mitral valve disease more than doubled to 16.1 million cases with an attributed 39,800 deaths in 2023. Moreover, mortality and disability were worse in women and low-resource areas, highlighting the need for affordable diagnostic and treatment tools.

items.title: TCT 2026: PROGRESS trial shows benefit for TAVI in moderate AS
items.summary: Patients with moderate aortic stenosis (AS) undergoing transcatheter aortic valve intervention (TAVI) had improved outcomes at two years than those left under clinical surveillance, results of the PROGRESS trial, presented during a late-breaking trials session at the Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT)…

items.title: TCT 2026: VERITAS trial reports out to one year for Amulet 360 LAA occluder
items.summary: Abbott has announced one-year results for its investigational Amulet 360 left atrial appendage (LAA) occluder from the VERITAS study, which it says show meaningful closure rates of the left atrial appendage and a low incidence of stroke in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) not caused by a heart valve issue.

items.title: TCT 2026: VERITAS trial reports out to one year for Amulet 360 LAA occluder
items.summary: Abbott has announced one-year results for its investigational Amulet 360 left atrial appendage (LAA) occluder from the VERITAS study, which the company says show meaningful closure rates of the LAA and a low incidence of stroke in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) not caused by a heart valve issue.

items.title: Domperidone prescribing guidance updated over severe hypertension risk
items.summary: A new contraindication for the dopamine receptor antagonist domperidone has been introduced by the Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA), advising that the medicine must no longer be used in patients with confirmed or suspected phaeochromocytoma due to a risk of severe hypertension.

items.title: Surmodics launches MetalPro direct-to-metal hydrophilic coatings for medical devices
items.summary: Surmodics has announced—at the opening of Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) 2026 (31 October–3 November, San Diego, USA)—the launch of its MetalPro direct-to metal ultraviolet (UV) cure hydrophilic coatings engineered to bond directly to metal surfaces without primers or tie-layers.

items.title: NODULE-SHOCK trial introduces “shave and shake” concept for nodular coronary calcium
items.summary: Combining rotational atherectomy and intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) before percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) may aid stent expansion in nodular coronary calcium.

items.title: TCT 2026 hears early results for Abbott coronary IVL system
items.summary: Abbott has reported positive 30-day results from the TECTONIC CAD IVL investigational device exemption (IDE) study, evaluating the use of its investigational SonicForce coronary IVL system.

items.title: TCT 2026: One-year results reported for Spur Elute sirolimus retrievable stent system
items.summary: Reflow Medical has announced presentation of one-year clinical results from the first-in-human DEEPER CORONARY study, evaluating the investigational coronary Spur Elute sirolimus-eluting retrievable stent system for coronary in-stent restenosis (ISR) at the 2026 Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT)…

items.title: First patients treated in TRIUMPH pivotal trial of prosthetic tricuspid valve
items.summary: Laplace Interventional has announced that the first three patients have been enrolled and treated in the randomised cohort of the TRIUMPH pivotal trial.

items.title: Higher dose heparin does not improve outcomes after PCI
items.summary: Results from the HD-PCI study show that a higher-dose unfractionated heparin (UFH) regimen did not improve clinical outcomes compared with a lower-dose strategy during percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).

items.title: TCT 2026: TRANSFORM II shows non-inferiority of sirolimus balloon in coronary de novo lesions
items.summary: For a second year running coronary drug-coated balloon (DCB) therapies have earned a primetime slot at the Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) meeting, with results of the TRANSFORM II study amongst the headline late-breakers presented on day two of the meeting’s 2026 instalment (31 October–3 November, San…

items.title: TCT 2026: Medtronic outlines trial of TAVI in moderate aortic stenosis
items.summary: Study design and baseline characteristics of patients enrolled in the Evolut EXPAND TAVR II trial were presented today as featured clinical science at the Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) conference (31 October–3 November, San Diego, USA).

items.title: TCT 2026 live blog
Rampart extends total-body radiation protection to interventional imagers with Vanguard launch
items.summary: Rampart has announced the launch of Rampart Vanguard—a new radiation protection solution that has been purpose-built for interventional imagers working at the head of the table.

items.title: CROWN-MV trial of Abbott’s Cephea mitral valve system commences
items.summary: Abbott has initiated the CROWN-MV pivotal trial evaluating the safety and effectiveness of its investigational Cephea mitral valve system in treating people with symptomatic mitral valve disease who are not candidates for surgery and transcatheter repair.

items.title: Philips launches new imaging software bringing CT-derived information into live procedures
items.summary: Royal Philips has announced the launch of Philips UniGuide 3D Live Guidance—an imaging solution bringing computed tomography (CT)-derived information into its Azurion imaging platform—in Europe and other CE-marked markets.

items.title: ZOLL wins direct-award defibrillator contract at new Velindre Cancer Centre
items.summary: Velindre University NHS Trust has awarded a direct contract worth £111,214 to ZOLL Medical UK Limited for defibrillators and accessories at the New Velindre Cancer Centre, concluded 15 October 2026 and published on Find a Tender on 30 October 2026.

Support and licensing agreement for Cardiac Magnetic Resonance (CMR) Post-Processing Software system to be used in Radiology for calculation of stroke volume, ejection fraction, and end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes and masses of cardiac ventricles.

items.title: Implantable bioelectronic pacemaker is first device manufactured at new UK device hub
items.summary: Ceryx Medical and King’s College London (London, UK) have announced that the first implantable device has been manufactured at MAISI—the national facility for the Manufacture of Active Implants and Surgical Instruments.

items.title: Implantable bioelectronic pacemaker is first device manufactured at new UK hub
items.summary: Ceryx Medical and King’s College London (London, UK) have announced that the first implantable device has been manufactured at the national facility for the Manufacture of Active Implants and Surgical Instruments (MAISI).

items.title: US FDA 510(k) — DLP Coronary Ostial Cannulae
Abbott’s transcatheter PVL occlusion device gains US FDA approval
items.summary: Abbott has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval for the Amplatzer Paraclose PVL Occluder, a transcatheter device designed to treat paravalvular leak (PVL)—the backflow of blood around a surgical heart valve.

items.title: Radiation safety in endovascular procedures—what are we still overlooking?
items.summary: As the topic of radiation safety across various interventional specialties continues to garner increased interest, Melissa Kirkwood (Dallas, USA) homes in on the under-recognised issue of clinician hand exposure during these procedures. For neurointerventionists, fluoroscopy is essential to guiding complex procedures.

items.title: UK government confirms indefinite recognition of CE-marked medical devices
items.summary: The UK government has confirmed that it will continue to accept CE-marked medical devices on a long-term basis, meaning devices and in-vitro diagnostic devices (IVDs) already approved for the EU market will remain available to patients across the UK.

items.title: UK government confirms indefinite recognition of CE-marked medical devices
items.summary: The UK government has confirmed that it will continue to accept CE-marked medical devices on a long-term basis, meaning devices and in vitro diagnostic devices (IVDs) already approved for the EU market will remain available to patients across the UK.

items.title: Medtronic announces positive real-world results on Sphere-9 catheter and PulseSelect PFA system at APHRS 2026
items.summary: Medtronic has announced positive real-world registry results for the Affera mapping and ablation system with the Sphere-9 catheter and the PulseSelect pulsed field ablation (PFA) system.

items.title: J&J reports real-world Varipulse Pro data and 12-month Omnypulse outcomes at APHRS 2026
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (J&J) has announced new data from the VARIPURE and Omny-IRE studies presented at the 2026 Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) annual meeting (21–24 October, Busan, South Korea). Both studies were published simultaneously in Europace and Heart Rhythm, respectively.

items.title: Pascal Precision system gains US FDA approval for tricuspid valve repair
items.summary: Edwards Lifesciences has announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved its Pascal Precision system for tricuspid valve repair.

items.title: German sites begin enrolment in PARADIGM trial of DurAVR TAVI valve
items.summary: Anteris Technologies has received full regulatory clearance from the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM) for the DurAVR transcatheter heart valve (THV) global pivotal trial for patients with severe calcific aortic stenosis—the PARADIGM trial—patient recruitment at leading German centres and…

items.title: Non-invasive FFR tool gains US FDA clearance
items.summary: Elucid has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance of FFR-IQ, its software for non-invasive estimation of fractional flow reserve (FFR) from coronary CT angiography (FFR-CT).

items.title: Johnson & Johnson launches Shockwave C2 Aero Fly coronary IVL catheter in the USA
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson has announced the US launch of its Shockwave C2 Aero Fly coronary intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) catheter, designed to treat a broad range of calcified coronary artery lesions.

items.title: Haemonetics announces US FDA approval of PerQseal Elite vascular closure system
items.summary: Haemonetics has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of the PerQseal Elite vascular closure system for large-bore arterial procedures.

items.title: Jupiter Endovascular reveals SPIRARE II results for Vertex thrombectomy system in intermediate-risk PE
items.summary: Jupiter Endovascular has announced the publication of full results from its SPIRARE II pivotal trial in EuroIntervention. The trial evaluated the Vertex thrombectomy system in patients with acute, intermediate-risk pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: Edwards' SAPIEN M3 delivery system linked to patient death in FDA alert
items.summary: Medical Device Network reports an FDA alert linking the Edwards SAPIEN M3 transcatheter delivery system to a patient death.

items.title: Study links statin use with lower risk of glaucoma
items.summary: People taking statins may have a lower risk of developing glaucoma or needing more intensive treatment for the condition, new research suggests. A study, published in the British Journal of Ophthalmology, found statin use was associated with a 15% lower risk of developing open-angle glaucoma.

items.title: Enrolment completed in study of Freesolve resorbable magnesium scaffold
items.summary: Teleflex Incorporated has announced the successful completion of patient enrolment in the BIOMAG-LL clinical study, evaluating the safety and clinical performance of the Freesolve resorbable magnesium scaffold (RMS) in 35mm and 40mm lengths for the treatment of de novo coronary lesions up to 38mm.

items.title: SPARX trial to compare paclitaxel DCBs to stenting in complex coronary disease
items.summary: Translumina has announced the launch of the SPARX trial, an international, multicentre, randomised clinical trial comparing a first-line drug-coated balloon (DCB) strategy against contemporary drug-eluting stents (DES) in patients with complex coronary artery disease.

items.title: Endovascular Engineering receives two US FDA 510(k) clearances for PE thrombectomy devices
items.summary: Endovascular Engineering (E2) has announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted 510(k) clearance for both the Hēlo thrombectomy system and Hēlo Return (blood return system).
